title: End-to-end launch-to-next-task call-graph review, transition/surface enumeration, and ten-class defect search (pre-code)
objective: Amendment-22 window step 1 (D-024-R383/R384, sequencing: BEFORE any code change). Review the COMPLETE launch-to-next-task call graph of tools/agent_supervisor: fresh-worker launch, orientation, checkpoint emission, checkpoint validation/persistence/forwarding, independent Codex review, verdict handling, exactly-once task advancement, next-task selection and dispatch, rotation/turnover, recovery/restart, and continued multi-unit operation. Enumerate EVERY intended state transition (state_machine documented transitions) and EVERY operating surface (CLI commands, runbook/owner-presented command shapes, durable state keys, audit events). Search specifically for the ten defect classes: unreachable edges; missing CLI arguments; command/runbook drift; primary-checkout leakage; resume-path differences; fixed-budget assumptions; stale durable state; duplicated actions; incomplete recovery transitions; differences between tested command shapes and owner-presented command shapes. Deliverables: (1) M0-T125-callgraph-and-transitions.md - the complete call-graph + transition/surface map with per-edge evidence (file:line); (2) M0-T125-defect-register.md - every defect found with class, evidence, in-scope/out-of-scope ruling and proposed correction, feeding M0-T126. READ-ONLY with respect to production code: no source changes in this task. Preserved live artifacts are read-only evidence (R374). QUALIFYING EVIDENCE (supervisor-freeze rule): live counted stop no_valid_checkpoint at exactly 12/12 turns after a fully-successful repaired launch (project-control/reports/M0-T107-amendment20-live-journey-2.md); window authorized by D-024-R372.
business_reason: Owner Amendment 22: one bounded final stabilization window; pre-code review is mandatory sequencing (R383)
path_free_justification: Pre-code analysis packet (D-024-R383/R384): deliverables are two NEW report files (M0-T125-callgraph-and-transitions.md, M0-T125-defect-register.md); the task changes no production code and binds no existing tracked content identity.
